title: Data source research candidate
description: One evaluated candidate from the research-sources procedure. Proposal only — never implies the source has been wired into app/sources/.

slug.description: Matches the candidate's filename stem and its memo's slug.

url.description: Primary docs/download page, not a deep API endpoint.

proposed_use.description: What in this codebase it would feed (a metric, an assumption default, a new pillar, etc).

granularity.description: Smallest geography the series is published at, e.g. county, CBSA/MSA, ZCTA, tract.

history_start.description: Earliest date/year of available history, or null if point-in-time only.

license.description: Public domain / ToS summary; must note any clause restricting commercial or product use.

cost.description: Must confirm genuinely free, not a trial, and note any rate limit.

correlation.description: Quantitative evaluation against FHFA HPI growth / Zillow ZORI via app/research/evaluate_series.py. Null when that tool doesn't exist yet — evaluation is then qualitative only, and the memo must say so plainly.
